story_type: pararescue team parachutes from an HC-130J into the open North Pacific to reach a sick sailor
hook: They jumped out of a plane over the open ocean to reach one sailor.
narration: These rescuers jumped out of a plane over the open North Pacific to reach one sick sailor.
In August 2025, a sailor on a South Korean fishing boat hundreds of miles out was critically ill.
So an Alaska Air National Guard HC-130J flew a team of five Guardian Angel rescuers out to him.
They stepped off the ramp, one after another.
A static line yanks each parachute open as the jumper falls away, so the canopy blooms in seconds.
[short pause] Below them, the canopies drifted down toward a sea that ran all the way to the horizon.
outcome: Aboard the boat, they stabilized the sailor, rode it into port at Adak, and got him to a hospital in Anchorage.
title: Parachuting to a sick sailor at sea
description:
On Aug. 8, 2025, Alaska Air National Guard Guardian Angels from the 212th Rescue Squadron jumped from a 211th Rescue Squadron HC-130J Combat King II over the North Pacific to medevac a critically ill sailor on a South Korean fishing vessel.

Footage: Alaska Air National Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1025592/212th-rescue-squadron-guardian-angels-jump-north-pacific-rescue-mariner
